description: Stop serving a temporary port or directory share created by expose_local_port or expose_local_directory: removes exactly the backend and frontend that call created, so its public URL no longer reaches the local target. Pass the returned name (or frontend_id). Fails for names those tools did not create. A share that was saved to the applied project's file is removed from it too.

name.description: The `name` (equal to the `frontend_id`) returned by either expose tool.

name: unexpose
